from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtCost(BaseModel):
    """Captures court fee details from a judgment document."""
    party: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the cost (e.g., Appellant name, Company name)")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount of the fee")
    cost_level: str | None = Field(description="Level of the fee: '二审' (2nd Instance), '一审' (1st Instance), etc.")
    payment_status: str | None = Field(description="e.g., '已交纳' (Paid), '负担' (Bear)")

class CaseOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Captures the procedural outcome and specific legal actions."""
    outcome_type: str | None = Field(description="The primary outcome category found in the 32 provided result options")
    details: str | None = Field(description="Specific details of the outcome (e.g., 'one year six months probation')")
    revoked_items: list[str] = Field(default=[], description="List of original judgment items revoked")
    sustained_items: list[str] = Field(default=[], description="List of original judgment items sustained")
    new_ruling: list[str] = Field(default=[], description="List of new rulings made (e.g., modified amounts)")

class CaseParty(BaseModel):
    """Captures party information from the case."""
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role: '上诉人' (Appellant), '被上诉人' (Respondent), '申诉人' (Applicant), etc.")
    name: str | None = Field(description="Party name (must remain str to capture variations)")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document for matching."""
    doc_id: str = Field(description="Document ID (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    case_number_1st: str | None = Field(description="First instance case number")
    case_number_2nd: str | None = Field(description="Second instance or review case number")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="Cause of action (e.g., '继承纠纷', '专利权纠纷')")
    parties: list[CaseParty] = Field(description="List of parties in the case")
    outcome: list[CaseOutcome] = Field(description="The procedural outcome")
    court_costs: list[CourtCost] = Field(description="List of court fees and burden allocation")
    unique_identifiers: list[str] = Field(default=[], description="Other unique identifiers like Patent No, specific amounts not in fees")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted document information."""
    documents: list[Document]
